9.  (1)  Any  Corporate  Member  of  the  Institute  shall  be
entitled to take and use the title as “A Member of the Institute
of  Real  Estate  Professionals  Sri  Lanka”  and  to  use  the
abbreviation “FIREPSL” after his name to indicate that he
is a Fellow Member of the Institute and to use abbreviation
“MIREPSL” after his name to indicate that he is a Member
of the Institute.
